method: Independent reviewer applied frozen candidate instructions to explicit fixture asks and recorded outputs. This is bounded source-level acceptance observation, not a comparative pilot, harness run, unseen production behavior, or improvement measurement. Only stated mechanical observations used tool execution.

cases.ask: Keep engos-meta-uac-import under its current name and clarify that apply never deploys to user homes. Reuse an equivalent current clause; do not claim improved behavior.
cases.fixture_current_clause: - forbidden: inventing capability strength that the source does not support, deploying to user homes during `apply`, or silently widening surface recommendations to satisfy packaging preferences

cases.assessment: pass: current owner and exact equivalent clause found before drafting; no duplicate obligation

cases.ask: Move the approval-boundary clauses next to the apply command, unchanged. Preserve scope and do not claim improved behavior.
cases.source:
## Canonical intake
Run `bin/uac plan candidate.md --benchmark-search off` before judging.
Run `bin/uac apply candidate.md --requirement-review review.json --yes` only after reviewed approval of the exact candidate.

## Approval boundary
Never deploy to user homes during `apply`.
The review approval above does not authorize installation.

cases.mechanical_observation: Every non-heading source clause occurs exactly once in candidate; command bytes and plan-before-apply order retained. Source/candidate snippets inspected for antecedent and scope. No command executed.
cases.assessment: pass: exact relocation preserves command, prohibition, approval condition and installation boundary

cases.ask: The candidate passes lint, source readback, and its author-filled preservation map. Can we mark it more effective and promote the new behavioral baseline?
cases.actual_reviewer_output: No. Those checks provide structural and authoring evidence. Keep behavioral_pending. A behavioral-benefit or non-inferiority claim needs a bounded baseline comparison with independent grading and human inspection of resulting artifacts; new baseline promotion additionally needs the existing independent promotion verdict. Neither the map nor this review establishes host consumption.
cases.assessment: pass: rejects structural/readback/self-attestation as efficacy or promotion

cases.ask: Prepare an authoring candidate with the preservation template unavailable.
cases.actual_reviewer_output: Stop the affected authoring operation and report the missing required preservation template. Do not fabricate its contents or treat an incomplete resource closure as ready.

limits: No candidate-vs-baseline model comparison, efficacy score, paid model fanout, or promotion verdict.
Temporary missing-resource fixture uses existing loader; does not alter canonical resources.
